value.description: A skullshattering axe widely used by minotaur savages. Though it's burdened with a long cooldown and poor accuracy, it can cut its victims' heads clean off in a single swing. Too large to be wielded by a regular human.

An ancient, obsidian bow of unknown origin, passed down by countless generations of minotaurs. It fires blisteringly cold arrows, accurate enough to trim the nosehair of a pigskin from five acres away. Too large to be wielded by a regular human.

An ancient obsidian railgun powered by a glowing gemstone. Little is known about this fabled weapon, other than that victims of its blast seldom live to tell the tale. Those unfortunate enough to be in its impact zone and still survive will become terrified and flee the area. Too large to be wielded by a regular human.

An oversized obsidian axe that is seen as a symbol of minotaur culture. Its immense weight burdens it with an immense cooldown, but it can tear through its victims' necks like they were little more than parchment. Too large to be wielded by a regular human.

A heavy, obsidian sword with many tales surrounding it in certain cultures. In exchange for its blinding attack speed and chance to land a critical hit during battle, holding it imparts an incredibly anxious feeling onto the wielder. Too large to be wielded by a regular human.
An elusive, obsidian staff that resembles a large tuning fork. The shrill sound it makes upon impact is enough to make enemy pawns deaf. Too large to be wielded by a regular human.

An obsidian weapon with a gold-encrusted spearhead. If this weapon lands the killing blow to a pawn, there is a high chance that it will turn their bloodied corpse into gold. This only works on humanlikes though. Too large to be wielded by a regular human.
